Income Tax Dept Searches Locations Linked to Rakul Preet Singh, Vashu Bhagnani

The Income Tax Department conducted searches at 12 locations reportedly linked to actor Rakul Preet Singh and producer Vashu Bhagnani. The searches are related to alleged fund irregularities. Panorama Studios was also mentioned in connection with the searches.
